source_message.text:
I've decided to upload the book to IPFS through Pinata initially, so I retain the option to take it down if the project does not succeed or the story is not well received.

How should access be limited to NFT holders? My current idea is to gate the PDF with Lit Protocol and point the metadata to a gated viewer that checks ownership automatically, without a manual wallet connection. I am open to another suggestion if it offers a smoother user experience.

The cover also still needs to be adjusted so the whole image is visible.

One more question: if the company registration is rejected again—it has already been rejected 11 times, although approval is expected next Monday—can we launch as crypto-only and add Transak in the following days or weeks once approval arrives?
